details: The package @servicetitan/carto-rn-kit@0.0.14 is a trojanized React Native component kit. Its preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases and executes a 728KB heavily-obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (math_init.js) containing eval, Function constructor, and child_process calls. The package depends on @servicetitan/carto-tokens which is also a malicious package. The obfuscated payload runs at install time via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
